name: UpdateDraftEmail
description: Updates an existing email draft in a specified Microsoft 365 mailbox using Microsoft Graph, with support for recipients, content, priority, and sensitivity.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select Microsoft 365 credentials used to authenticate the request.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the draft email.

fields.name: DraftId
fields.label: Draft ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the draft email to update.

fields.name: To
fields.label: To
fields.description: Primary recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: CC
fields.label: CC
fields.description: Carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: BCC
fields.label: BCC
fields.description: Blind carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Updated subject line of the draft email.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: Format of the email body content.

fields.name: Content
fields.label: Body
fields.description: Updated content of the draft email. The format should match the selected Content Type.

fields.name: Importance
fields.label: Importance
fields.description: Specifies the importance level of the draft email.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The updated draft email returned by Microsoft Graph, including its ID and metadata.
